reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: All 3 gates passed. Gate 1 skipped (missing post-condition, not dead code). Gate 2: no trust_assumptions defined; POST /oauth/token is a public external endpoint. Gate 3: src/app/oauth/ is explicitly in scope. Spec assertion is clearly violated — handleConsent and the token endpoint produce only ephemeral console.log output with no audit_log table writes anywhere in src/. However, the stated attack path requires a pre-existing stolen client_secret, making the logging gap an incident-response impairment rather than a directly exploitable vulnerability; attack path certainty is uncertain.
